chapter.verse: Tua ciangin Jesu in mihonpi leh ama' nungzuite' kiangah hih thu teng gen hi:
“Laisiamte leh Pharisee-te Moses' tutphah tungah tu uh hi.
Tua ahih manin note' kianga hong gen peuhpeuh uh hihin zui unla, ahi zongin amau' hih bangin hih kei un. A hang pen amau' thugen amaumah in zui lo uh hi.
Tua mite in vangik a puak-hak dingte bawl uh a, mite' liangko ah suan napi-un amaumah in tua vangikte a khin dingin a khutme nangawn uh liik nuamlo uh hi.
A sep khempeuh uh midangte' muh theih dingin hih uh hi. A talsuante uh leh a banbulhte uh zaisak deda uh a, a puansilh khaukai uh sausak uh hi.
Pawi sungah mithupite' tutna mun ut uh a, vengkhawm innte ah tutphah hoihpen deih uh hi.
Sumbuktualte ah mi' hopih ding leh Rabbi a kicih ding ut uh hi.
Ahi zongin note pen Rabbi hong kicih ding hilo hi; a hang pen Sya khat bek na nei uh a, note na vekun sanggam khat na hi uh hi.
Tua ciangin leitung ah kuamah, na zuapa bangun sam kei un; a hang pen vantunga om Zuapa khat bek na nei uh hi.
Tua mah bangin note zong syate kicisak kei un; a hang pen Khris kici Sya khat bek na nei uh hi.
Note' lakah a lianpente note' nasem hiding hi.
Amahmah a kisanglap peuhpeuh kiniamkoih ding a, amahmah a kiniamkhiat peuhpeuh kisanglap ding hi.
“Tu-in no a puatham kineih laisiamte leh Pharisee-te, na dahhuaizia uh! A hang pen mite' mai-ah vantung kumpigam kongpi na khakcip uh a, no lah lut lo-in a lut nuamte lah na phal kei uh hi.

(No a puatham kineih, laisiamte leh Pharisee-te aw, na dahhuaizia uh! A hang pen note in meigongte' innlelo teng na nektumsak uh a, tua na seelna-un thungetna saupipi na nei uh hi. Tua hangin thukhenna a khauhzaw na thuak ding uh hi.)

“No a puatham kineih laisiamte leh Pharisee-te aw, na dahhuaizia uh! A hang pen biakna lutthak khat na ngah nadingun tuili leh leigam kantanin khual na zin uh a, khat hong kihei ciangin lah note sangin a zah nih-a siahuaizaw hell khuami khat na suah uh hi.

“No khuamulo lamhilhte aw, na dahhuaizia uh! A hang pen note in, ‘Mi khatpeuh biakinnpi tawh a kiciam leh phamawh lo a, ahi zongin biakinnpi sunga kham tawh a kiciam leh tua kiciamna in amah khih hi,’ na ci uh hi.
No khuamulo mihaite aw, kham leh tua kham zeksak a suaksak biakinnpi, koi thupizaw ahi hiam?
Note in, ‘Mi khatpeuh biakpiaktau tawh a kiciam leh bangmah phamawh lo a, ahi zongin biakpiaktau tunga biakpiak van tawh a kiciam leh tua kiciamna in amah khih hi,’ na ci uh hi.
No khuamulote aw, biakpiak van leh tua biakpiak van zeksak a suaksak biakpiaktau, koi thupizaw ahi hiam?
Tua hi a, biakpiaktau tawh a kiciam peuhpeuh biakpiaktau leh tua biakpiaktau tunga om na khempeuh tawh a kiciam ahi hi.
Biakinnpi tawh a kiciam peuhpeuh biakinnpi leh tua biakinnpi sunga a teengpa tawh a kiciam ahi hi.
Vantung tawh a kiciam peuhpeuh Pasian' kumpi-tokhom leh tua tunga a tupa tawh a kiciam ahi hi.

“No a puatham kineih laisiamte leh Pharisee-te aw, na dahhuaizia uh! A hang pen note in lengmasel, dill tang namtui, cumin anteh namtui cihte sawm-ah-khat sumpi pia napi uhcin thukhun sunga a thupizawte ahi thumaan thutang, thukhualna, cihtakna cihte na pampaih uh hi. A dangte zong pampaih tuanlo-in hih thute na zuih ding uh ahi hi.
No khuamulo lamhilhte aw, na tuidawn uhah thosi thovai khaihkhia napi uhcin kalaoh na nawmvalh uh hi.

“No a puatham kineih laisiamte leh Pharisee-te aw, na dahhuaizia uh! A hang pen hai leh kuangte a pualam na sawpsiang uh a, ahi zongin a sunglam ah duhhop huaihamna leh pumpi ki-uklahna a dimin om hi.
Khuamulo Pharisee-te aw, hai leh kuang a pualam a sian theih nadingin a sunglam sawpsiang masa un.

“No a puatham kineih laisiamte leh Pharisee-te aw, na dahhuaizia uh! A hang pen leikang kizut hankhuk na bang uh hi. Tua hankhuk a pualam hoihsuah napi a sungah misi guh leh nin kihhuai namkim a dimin om hi.
Note zong a pualam ah a dik na bang uh a, ahi zongin na sung uhah puatham kineihna leh thukhun pampaihna tawh na kidim uh hi.
“No a puatham kineih laisiamte leh Pharisee-te aw, na dahhuaizia uh! A hang pen kamsangte' ading hankhuk bawlin midikte' mualsuang na zem uh a,
‘I pu i pate' khanlai-in a omkha hi lehang kamsangte sisan naisan a luansakna uh i pawlpih kei ding hi,’ na ci uh hi.
Tua bang na cihna uhah kamsang a that, tualthatte' suanlekhakte na hihlam uh nomaumah teci a pang na hi uh hi.
Tua hi a, na pu na pate' maban mah zomsuak vet un.
No gulte aw, mualtan' suante aw, hell tun nading thukhenna pan bangci suahtak theih ding na hi uh hiam?

“Tua thu hangin note' kiangah kamsangte, mipilte leh laisiamte kong paisak ding hi. Tuate kimkhat thatin na khailum ding uh a, kimkhat na vengkhawm innte uhah satin khua khat pan khua khat ah bawlsia-in na hawlkhia ding uh hi.
Tua huhau-in midik Abel' sisan-a kipan biakinnpi leh biakpiaktau kikal-a na tualthah uh Barachiah' tapa Zechariah ii sisan dong, leitunga midik sisan a luang khempeuh note' tungah hong tung ding hi.
Maantak kong cihin ah hih thute khempeuh tu-a khangmite' tungah hong tung ding hi.
“Aw Jerusalem, Jerusalem aw, kamsangte a that, ama' kianga kisawl mite a denglum khuapi! Akpi in a no teng a kha nuai-ah a huai bangin na tate ka huai nuam den a, ahi zongin nang na ut kei hi.
En in, na inn uh a hawmpi-in note' kiangah hong kinusiat hi.
A hang pen note kong cihin ah: ‘Topa' min tawh hong pai mipa thuphangah ahi hi!’ na cih matengun tu-a kipan kei nong mukik kei ding uh hi.”
